notes: Environmental and visual similarity are rescaled across the candidate set before fusing, so the weight controls influence. Scores therefore rank within one target and are not an absolute physical measurement.
Elevation and aridity are dropped for every target: heights use a different reference surface on each world, and aridity is defined from rainfall.
Earth tiles are blurred to each target's own ground resolution before comparison.
A target whose tile is flat, such as a permanently shadowed crater, is scored on environment alone and marked visual_scoring=false.
pipeline.disclaimer: Similarity in selected measured features, not physical equivalence.

validation_summary.benchmark_scope: The 11 known analogues are all dry rocky sites, so the benchmark can only judge targets of that kind. Ice targets are reported but not counted, which is stated rather than hidden.
validation_summary.honest_note: On this benchmark the environmental channel alone separates known from control more cleanly than the fusion does. The weight was fixed in advance and was not moved to flatter the result.
